audit.whatIsWrong: The disk chart gave Poppy levels 2, 3, first item and two items, but the prose on those rows reads 'win the level-2 all-in before she can answer', 'win nearly any level-3 all-in', 'these levels are yours', 'your hardest pre-late window'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Poppy) matches the prose and the 52.67% win rate. Kled owns 2 through first item; Poppy reclaims it only once she is a finished tank, which whys[6] and spikes[3] already say.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 through 5 flipped to Kled in both layers as one group; row 0 stays Skill and row 6 stays Poppy.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said to commit 'when her Steadfast Presence is down' without giving the number that makes the window real.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12 — a 20-second hole at rank 1, by far the longest cooldown that matters in this lane. That is the difference between 'bait the W' as a slogan and as a plan.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states 20s at rank 1 and that it only stops dashes around her.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json (W cd 20/18/16/14/12, 'stop enemy dashes around her')

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places claim Poppy has a Q knockup — 'then Q-knockup you out of your re-E combo' and 'I eat a Q-knockup and lose the trade'.
audit.why: Hammer Shock deals damage and creates a zone that slows and explodes after a delay. There is no knockup on it. Her only knockup is Keeper's Verdict (R). A player expecting to be tossed by a 430-range Q will misread every trade.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] and early rewritten to Hammer Shock's slow-and-detonate zone.
sources: champ-data/_kits/poppy.json (Q Hammer Shock, R Keeper's Verdict)

audit.whatIsWrong: Iron Ambassador is never mentioned. Poppy throws her buckler, and picking it back up gives her a shield.
audit.why: The shield is free trade equity and it is denied by standing on the shard. That is a concrete thing to do during your combo rather than a stat to accept.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d rewritten to denying the buckler pickup.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is headed 'Get R-knocked mid-trade' but its body is unrelated template text.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict is a 140s-at-rank-1 channelled hammer strike. Both the cooldown and the fact that it is channelled with a visible wind-up belong on that line.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to the 140s channel and walking out of the swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Several full-layer lines call Poppy 'he' and 'his'.
audit.why: Poppy is female and the content layer uses 'she' throughout — the same matchup page disagrees with itself.

edits.before: Level 1 I concede — I have no spammable poke and I want to keep Skaarl's health bar full, so I just farm and wait for my spike. From level 2 it's mine: Violent Tendencies comes online and my fourth-and-after shots chunk her, and by 3 I have the full E-W-E re-E with Bear Trap on a Rope to lock her. Her one real answer early is Steadfast Presence — her W stops my E dash mid-flight — so don't waste my engage into it; bait the W, then re-E in and let my percent-HP Q and Skaarl's free health win the all-in. Dodge her E: if she pins me to a wall for the stun I eat a Q-knockup and lose the trade.
edits.after: Level 1 I concede — I have no spammable poke and I want to keep Skaarl's health bar full, so I just farm and wait for my spike. From level 2 it's mine: Violent Tendencies comes online and my fourth-and-after shots chunk her, and by 3 I have the full E-W-E re-E with Bear Trap on a Rope to lock her. Her one real answer early is Steadfast Presence — her W stops my E dash near her — so don't waste my engage into it; bait the W on its 20s, then re-E in and let my percent-HP Q and Skaarl's free health win the all-in. Dodge Heroic Charge: pinned on a wall, I eat the stun and her Hammer Shock zone detonates on me.

notes: Hammer Shock and Keeper's Verdict both carry derived 'grounding' flags, and Keeper's Verdict also carries 'untargetable' and 'channel — any CC cancels it'. Riot's own text supports none of those except that R is channelled ('Poppy channels a hammer strike'). I wrote only the channel, and no grounding or interrupt claim. If confirmed that Bear Trap's yank cancels Keeper's Verdict, that is worth a dedicated line. The packet suspectName 'Hold Steadfast Presence' in wants.foe[0] is a FALSE POSITIVE — the ability name is correct, the scanner caught the leading verb. Packet reports games as 131 while the brief header says 213.
